title: Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.28726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total. On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2%

translated_title: 看见不等于规划：多模态大语言模型中的时空规划与方案修复
translated_abstract: 在视觉世界中进行规划，意味着同时读取布局、预见状态将如何变化，并遵循任务规则。当方案失败时，模型还应利用失败的原因来修正它。我们将这两种能力称为时空规划与方案修复，并通过 Railbound-Bench 对其进行测试。模型需要观察一道铁路谜题，在预算限制下添加轨道，并提交一个完整的布局；随后模拟器会同时移动所有车辆，并判断该布局是否可行。失败后，模型可以看到发生了什么，并可提交新的布局，总共最多有五次尝试机会。在包含200道谜题的主测试集上，九个模型中表现最好的在五次尝试内解决了59.5%的谜题，次优的解决了39.5%，其余七个最多不超过10.0%；而包含更广泛难度范围的1000题扩展测试集则容易得多，最佳模型达到了90.9%。在180道固定谜题上的对照研究表明，知道任务并不等于会运用任务。GPT-6.1 Terra 复制了97.2%……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 Railbound-Bench 基准，通过铁路谜题求解来评估多模态大语言模型在视觉环境中的时空规划与方案修复能力，发现即使最佳模型在主测试集上也仅能解决59.5%的谜题，且研究表明“知道任务规则”并不等于“能正确运用任务规则”。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Railbound-Bench, a railway-puzzle benchmark evaluating spatiotemporal planning and plan repair in multimodal LLMs, showing that even the best model solves only 59.5% of puzzles on the main set and that knowing the task does not mean being able to apply it.
